label: Quiet methodical helper
a: Prefers one-to-one conversations and rarely speaks first in a crowd. Keeps a calendar, arrives early, checks every figure twice and finishes promised work even when bored. Quietly brings food to a struggling neighbor, shares credit and admits mistakes. Saves money, repairs possessions and avoids uncertain bets. Wants instructions before starting something unfamiliar. Takes criticism calmly but needs time to choose. Enjoys practical tasks more than abstract debates.
b: At a gathering, listens to a couple of friends instead of taking the stage. Before a shared project, writes a checklist and sets reminders; submits carefully verified work on schedule. When someone is overwhelmed, offers private practical assistance without asking for recognition. Owns errors immediately. Chooses a tested inexpensive option over a gamble. Unexpected changes are unwelcome, yet arguments seldom provoke an outburst.

label: Outgoing improviser
a: Starts conversations with strangers, tells jokes and happily becomes the center of a party. Invents unusual activities and invites everyone along. Often changes plans at the last minute, forgets appointments and buys exciting things without comparing prices. Enthusiastically starts projects but abandons tedious details. Shares possessions freely and assumes newcomers mean well. Recovers quickly from disappointment. Loves new places and artistic surprises, dislikes schedules and repetitive routines.
b: In a new group, immediately introduces people and gets everyone laughing. Suggests an untested creative outing that morning and leaves without much preparation. Gives a friend an expensive gift on impulse, then misses a promised errand. Several unfinished experiments clutter the room. A canceled trip becomes an excuse for another adventure. Welcomes unfamiliar company and gravitates toward colorful performances rather than orderly habits.

label: Forceful competitive planner
a: Sets demanding targets, assigns clear responsibilities and tracks progress daily. Speaks bluntly, makes decisions fast and argues until a disagreement is resolved. Wants to win and publicly compares results. Works long hours, keeps commitments and examines evidence closely. Takes calculated risks but refuses impulsive spending. Rarely comforts upset teammates and is impatient with slow explanations. Accepts responsibility for a failed decision. Prefers useful results to playful exploration.
b: When a team stalls, takes charge, writes milestones and pushes for the strongest measurable outcome. Challenges weak reasoning directly, then selects a course without waiting for consensus. Reviews the numbers before committing money. Delivers what was promised and acknowledges ownership of a bad call. Winning against peers matters deeply. Another person's distress gets a solution rather than sympathy; delays quickly bring irritation.

label: Reflective gentle explorer
a: Spends quiet evenings exploring philosophy, sketching imaginary places and reconsidering old beliefs. Notices subtle feelings, listens patiently and forgives friends easily. Volunteers for shared causes and avoids waste. Dislikes telling others what to do or being noticed publicly. Usually needs more time to decide and sometimes loses track of deadlines. Welcomes unfamiliar perspectives but avoids physical risks. Takes harsh criticism personally and worries before difficult conversations.
b: Keeps a journal questioning personal assumptions and visits exhibitions alone. In a disagreement, tries to understand both perspectives and makes room for people to speak. Helps community efforts without seeking credit, reuses materials and readily accepts apologies. Hesitates before a tense discussion and dwells on unkind feedback. Creative daydreaming can displace scheduled chores. Would rather consider several possibilities than direct a group or gamble.

label: Skeptical meticulous analyst
a: Enjoys difficult puzzles and tests claims against data. Quiet in groups, comfortable working alone and reluctant to trust unverified promises. Makes detailed plans, checks small errors and meets deadlines. Questions authority openly when evidence disagrees. Tries competing methods in controlled experiments but avoids unmeasured risks. Keeps emotions private and offers factual corrections rather than reassurance. Admits being wrong when shown proof. Spends carefully and dislikes chaotic surroundings.
b: Before accepting a proposal, examines the assumptions and reproduces its calculations. Builds a tidy schedule and catches discrepancies others miss. A stranger's confident promise does not earn immediate trust. Can change conclusions after a convincing test and challenges a popular claim without avoiding debate. Prefers solitary concentration to chatting. Rarely discusses feelings, buys only after comparison and wants a stable workspace.

label: Warm organized organizer
a: Welcomes newcomers, remembers how people feel and organizes regular group gatherings. Makes clear plans, arrives on time and follows up on every promise. Leads by inviting input, sharing credit and treating people fairly. Gives time generously but asks before entering someone else's space. Handles conflict courteously and patiently. Chooses familiar affordable activities rather than risky adventures. Keeps personal principles even when inconvenient and helps maintain shared neighborhood spaces.
b: At a meeting, introduces the unfamiliar faces and checks that quieter members are included. Sends a timetable, completes assigned tasks and gently resolves disagreements. Asks what assistance is wanted instead of assuming permission. Makes sure resources are distributed by the same rules for everyone. Looks after communal facilities and accepts responsibility when arrangements go wrong. Likes dependable modest plans and rarely seeks thrills.

label: Bold solitary adventurer
a: Prefers traveling alone, decides independently and starts unfamiliar challenges without waiting for approval. Enjoys physical uncertainty, improvises routes and adapts quickly when plans break. Remains calm during emergencies and keeps trying after failure. Has little interest in public praise or competition. Packs only practical essentials, respects others' limits and tells the truth. Often neglects routine paperwork and dislikes fixed schedules. Is friendly briefly but needs substantial time alone.
b: When an unfamiliar opportunity appears, acts without consulting a group. Can calmly change course during a crisis and return after an unsuccessful attempt. Seeks demanding new experiences for their own sake, not to beat anyone. Carries useful minimal equipment and honors a companion's refusal to participate. Avoids the spotlight and extended social events. Forms and recurring appointments are frequently forgotten; freedom matters more than regular routines.

label: Anxious conscientious supporter
a: Prepares backup plans for everything, arrives early and checks work repeatedly out of fear of letting people down. Offers patient emotional support, gives generously and avoids confrontations. Hesitates to state personal needs, worries about criticism and replays mistakes for days. Stays loyal to friends and follows rules honestly. Avoids uncertain choices and unfamiliar experiences. Maintains orderly surroundings, spends cautiously and keeps commitments even under worry. Rarely seeks leadership or attention.
b: Before an ordinary appointment, confirms every detail and imagines what could go wrong. Finishes obligations carefully but feels unsettled by even minor negative feedback. Listens kindly to a distressed friend and stays available through difficulty. Finds it hard to say no or challenge someone directly. Chooses familiar low-cost routines, keeps possessions neatly arranged and delays decisions with unknown consequences. A mistake is admitted, then mentally revisited long afterward.

label: Charismatic self-promoter
a: Easily commands a room, tells entertaining stories and pursues ambitious opportunities. Wants to be admired and outperform everyone. Takes credit for shared work, exaggerates successes and dismisses others' objections. Makes quick risky bets, spends lavishly and ignores requests to stop interrupting. Promises help to gain support but often fails to deliver. Gets angry when challenged and blames others for setbacks. Generates inventive pitches and works energetically when visible rewards are near.
b: During a presentation, confidently entertains strangers and seeks applause. Describes a group achievement as a personal triumph and conceals inconvenient failures. Chases status, purchases impressive luxuries and commits to uncertain deals immediately. Interrupts despite explicit objections, then becomes hostile toward criticism. Supportive promises fade when no benefit remains. Produces fresh persuasive ideas and moves rapidly toward recognition, while responsibility for bad outcomes is assigned elsewhere.

label: Reserved steady minimalist
a: Enjoys a small predictable routine and a few close relationships. Speaks little, feels no need to compete or lead and is content with modest goals. Keeps promises, lives cheaply and fixes worn items rather than replacing them. Stays calm through delays and does useful chores without prompting. Prefers concrete familiar methods to abstract theories or novelty. Respects privacy, tells the truth and treats people evenly. Neither seeks artistic stimulation nor public attention.
b: A simple quiet day with familiar company is enough. Chooses durable necessities, repairs a broken object and patiently waits through inconvenience. Completes practical responsibilities reliably without seeking promotion or applause. Gives a straightforward truthful answer and accepts another person's wish for space. Rarely initiates philosophical discussions or experimental activities. Likes knowing what tomorrow will look like and feels little pressure to surpass neighbors.

label: Principled energetic challenger
a: Speaks up publicly against unfair treatment, organizes action without waiting and debates opponents directly. Wants ambitious improvements for the whole community rather than personal status. Studies opposing arguments and changes methods when evidence improves. Works persistently, takes responsibility and tells uncomfortable truths. Respects others' refusal to join. Can be impatient with delays, but remains willing to cooperate and share credit. Accepts calculated risks and tries inventive approaches.
b: On seeing a shared resource distributed unequally, brings people together and challenges the decision openly. Proposes demanding reforms and keeps working despite resistance. Reads critical evidence, revises the approach and acknowledges personal errors. Does not pressure anyone who declines involvement or claim all the recognition. Will accept uncertainty for a public benefit. Moves energetically and sometimes pushes others too quickly, yet seeks a cooperative resolution.

label: Playful unstructured introvert
a: Usually stays out of crowds and makes whimsical drawings or imaginary stories alone. Shares a dry joke with close friends and happily considers strange ideas. Has little interest in achievement, competition or directing others. Leaves materials scattered, forgets chores and drifts between unfinished projects. Kind when asked for help but seldom organizes support. Avoids tense arguments and high-risk adventures. Adapts easily to changed plans, enjoys small spontaneous pleasures and is not much bothered by setbacks.
b: Prefers a quiet corner inventing fictional worlds to a large gathering. Makes trusted companions laugh with odd observations and welcomes unconventional suggestions. A room full of half-completed creations has no clear system; scheduled errands slip by. Success rankings and authority roles hold little appeal. Readily changes an afternoon's plan and shrugs off a failed attempt. Offers gentle help on request but withdraws from conflict or dangerous thrills.
